perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: September 17 Lockheed/U.S. Department of War framework to accelerate AIM-260 JATM production remains the freshest material primary execution signal; it supports demand visibility but does not by itself quantify booked revenue or margin.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Production acceleration supports long-duration demand, while actual economics remain gated by funding, award structure, industrial ramp, supply chain and program execution.

contradictions: Strong demand visibility coexists with material cash-flow timing and program-charge volatility.

lineage.searchStrategy: direct primary evidence reused; economics remain explicitly unknown rather than inferred
